the Virasoro algebra is realized in terms of the complex structure of a complex manifold.

the Virasoro algebra can be realized in a geometric way as a subalgebra of the Lie algebra of holomorphic vector fields on an infinite dimensional Kahler manifolds, and the discrete series of the Virasoro group can be realized in the space of polynomials on this infinite dimensional Kahler space.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following problems: 1. To find an appropriate Kahler structure on M. 2. To construct a natural complex coordinates on it. 3. To realize the Virasoro algebra in the space of functions on M. The first two problems are solved in this paper and the third one is under consideration.

the discrete series of Vir is a geometric object, which is the space of holomorhic functions on the Kahler manifold M.
the Virasoro algebra can be understood as a deformation of the algebra of holomorphic vector fields on M.
